description: NASA SMAP L3 radiometer daily 36 km soil moisture (SPL3SMP V009) via Earthdata Cloud OPeNDAP, subset to Taiwan and averaged to months (#90).

variables.name_zh: 表層土壤水（SMAP 衛星反演）
variables.name_en: Surface soil moisture, satellite retrieval (SMAP L3 36 km)
variables.definition_zh: 地表往下約 5 公分的土壤裡，每立方公尺的土有幾立方公尺是水；由 SMAP 衛星的 L 波段微波輻射計反演。
variables.note_zh: 只用官方建議品質（retrieval_qual_flag 為 0 或 8）的像元；台灣多山多植被、近海，有效日與有效月都少。單位是體積含水量，GLDAS 是 0–10 cm 的 kg m-2，對照要用標準化距平（docs/data/sources/smap.md）。
variables.source_long_name: Representative DCA soil moisture measurement for the Earth based grid cell.
variables.citation: O'Neill, P. E., S. Chan, E. G. Njoku, T. Jackson, R. Bindlish, and J. Chaubell. SMAP L3 Radiometer Global Daily 36 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture, Version 9. NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/4XXOGX0OOW1S
variables.data_kind_note: SMAP L-band radiometer brightness temperatures inverted to soil moisture with the Dual Channel Algorithm (SPL3SMP V009 baseline); a satellite retrieval, not a model output, and the input of neither GLDAS nor FLDAS.
